alt: The values, then the values with the target subtracted, then their prefix sums. Cells holding the same prefix value are marked together, and each pair of them bounds a stretch whose shifted sum is zero. The last step counts the pairs.

steps.caption: The values are 4 7 1 3 5 2 and the target average is 3.
Subtract 3 from each one. A stretch with average 3 now adds up to exactly 0.
The prefix sums of the shifted values, from the empty prefix prefix[0] = 0 up to prefix[6]. The sum of a stretch is one prefix minus an earlier one.
prefix[2] and prefix[5] are both 5, so the stretch of elements 2 to 4 sums to 5 - 5 = 0. That is 1 matching pair.
prefix[3] and prefix[4] are both 3, so the stretch of element 3 sums to 3 - 3 = 0. That is 1 matching pair.
The answer is the number of pairs of equal prefix values: 2.
The values are 3 3 3 3 and the target average is 3.
Subtract 3 from each one. A stretch with average 3 now adds up to exactly 0.
The prefix sums of the shifted values, from the empty prefix prefix[0] = 0 up to prefix[4]. The sum of a stretch is one prefix minus an earlier one.
The value 0 appears 5 times, at prefixes 0, 1, 2, 3, 4. Any two of them bound a stretch with sum 0: 5 * 4 / 2 = 10 pairs.
The answer is the number of pairs of equal prefix values: 10.
The values are 1 1 1 1 1 and the target average is 3.
Subtract 3 from each one. A stretch with average 3 now adds up to exactly 0.
The prefix sums of the shifted values, from the empty prefix prefix[0] = 0 up to prefix[5]. The sum of a stretch is one prefix minus an earlier one.
No prefix value repeats, so no stretch sums to 0 and none has the target average.
The answer is the number of pairs of equal prefix values: 0.
